question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who does not show response to good or bad
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stoic"** means someone who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining. (असंवेदनशील)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite the chaos around her, she remained stoic and calm.
 
 
 
• **"Stoic" **refers to a person who does not show response to good or bad events. (असंवेदनशील)
 
 
• **Example: **He was stoic in the face of criticism and did not let it affect him.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sceptic** (संशयवादी): A person inclined to question or doubt accepted opinions.

 
 
• **Example:** As a sceptic, she questioned all the traditional beliefs.
 
 
 
• **Cynic** (निंदक): A person who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest.
 
 
• **Example: **He is a cynic who always doubts the intentions of others.
 
 
 
• **Phobic** (फोबिक): A person who has an extreme or irrational fear of something.
 
 
• **Example:** She is phobic about spiders and can't stand being near them.
